item.title: Worldview Weekly — November 5, 2026
item.description: Welcome to Worldview Weekly for November fifth, twenty twenty-six, a global analytical complement and counterweight to The Economist. This week we ask what holds a system together, and what makes it capable of change. Our readings range from financial markets and regional organizations to scientific measurement and cultural memory. We look for explanations that a familiar headline can obscure. A useful counterweight does more than reverse somebody else's conclusion. It changes the question, brings a different place into view, or asks what evidence would distinguish two plausible explanations.
